title: justicia pozuzoensis
intro: Justicia pozuzoensis, commonly known as Peruvian lantana, is a plant species within the family Acanthaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine in Peru and other parts of South America, valued for its numerous health benefits and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Justicia pozuzoensis include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and protect against various infections. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
